hypotheses.rationale: At Step 6, WebSurfer clearly retrieved the wrong URL (Harry Potter) instead of Princess Diaries. The Planner at Step 7 failed to correct this critical error or ask for clarification regarding the mismatch between the requested movie and the retrieved content. Instead, it blindly instructed WebSurfer to proceed with citing sources from the wrong page, thereby inheriting the data corruption that led to the final hallucinated answer.

tags.evidence: The agent navigated to the IMDb URL 'tt0241527/fullcredits' intended for The Princess Diaries but the browser returned the 'Harry Potter and the Sorcerer's Stone' page instead of the requested content.
Upon retrying the same URL 'tt0241527/fullcredits', the agent again fetched the 'Harry Potter and the Sorcerer's Stone' page, failing to retrieve the requested data for The Princess Diaries.

Despite the URL returning the wrong movie's content, the agent instructed WebSurfer to proceed with checking the page and cite sources without attempting to correct the URL or question why the wrong movie was loaded.
The Planner instructs WebSurfer to 'Open IMDb page: https://www.imdb.com/title/tt0241527/fullcredits/' which is the Harry Potter ID, not the Princess Diaries ID.
The Planner provides an incorrect URL 'https://www.imdb.com/title/tt0247638/fullcredits/' for The Princess Diaries, confusing it with another film, and instructs WebSurfer to open this wrong page.

The Planner incorrectly states that Julie Andrews plays 'Helen Thermopolis' (the protagonist) and outputs this as the final answer, failing to correct the factual error or verify the mother's character name despite having access to the IMDb page.
